title: Cheekatilo
plot_overview: After her best friend dies under suspicious circumstances, a crime anchor leaves sensationalist television behind and launches a podcast focused on raw investigations. Her search for answers draws attention from a dangerous killer, forcing her to confront buried trauma while becoming a voice for victims and the silenced.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you prefer slow-burn crime dramas with emotional depth and a serious mood, like Thimmarusu: Assignment Vali; Not for you if you want relentless suspense or tightly plotted twists.
review_summary: Pros: restrained lead performance; mature emotional tone; engaging social focus | Cons: uneven pacing; predictable thriller elements; underwhelming payoff
